scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,web,bff --prefix-colors yellow,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @rekognition-manager/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @rekognition-manager/web" "npm run dev --workspace @rekognition-manager/bff"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/contracts && npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/bff && npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/web
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/contracts && npm run openapi:generate --workspace @rekognition-manager/bff
scripts.openapi:check: npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/contracts && npm run openapi:check --workspace @rekognition-manager/bff
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @rekognition-manager/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
